title: Vandermonde construction work as a sum
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, set $\ell=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, with $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ denoting the least natural number $r$ such that $2^r\ge n$. The executable Vandermonde construction work is the sum of the binary field preprocessing work at parameter $\ell$ and $n$ times one plus the sum, over $q=0,\ldots,k-2$, of the executable small-bias power work at parameter $\ell$ and exponent $q+1$, together with $\ell+1$.
